title: QPU
description:
An exact quantum processing unit served over MCP at https://qpu.uuidna.com, with its site, admin and API on the same host. Reads need no auth; storage writes need a Bearer token. Use it as an MCP server ({ "qpu": { "type": "http", "url": "https://qpu.uuidna.com/mcp" } }), as a package (npm install @uuidna/qpu), or as a container.
